verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator and platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The pack never mentions MCP. The 'server' references (the -s headless flag, the gz-sim-server package) describe the simulation server, not an MCP endpoint. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI all returned 404, so there is no evidence of agent-facing interfaces either.
